sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Eden Selectboard members: Timothy Bullard (Chair), Ricky Morin, and Clayton Whittemore.

Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists Tim Bullard (term to 2028), Ricky Morin (2027), and Clayton Whittemore (2026); the June 2026 directory seats all three after the March 2026 meeting, so Whittemore holds the seat that stood in 2026.
Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists Melissa Whitcomb as Town Clerk on a 3-year term.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator for a one-year term at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists H. Bruce Burnor as Moderator with his term expired March 2026; no official source publishes the 2026 outcome, so the seat is left unfilled.

Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists Leslie White as Auditor (term to 2028), Julie Gates appointed May 27, 2025 to a seat expiring 2026, and Ronald Miller resigned March 24, 2025 with no successor named; only White's seat is filled here.

Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists five Cemetery Commissioners on 5-year terms: David Deery (2027), Jubal Durivage (President, 2028), Colleen Durivage (2029), Adam Degree (2030), and Faye Cochran (2026); Cochran's seat stood in 2026 with no published outcome, so four are minted.

Town of Eden 2024-25 Annual Town Report (edenvt.org): the TOWN OFFICERS table lists Melissa Whitcomb (2027), Trevor Bidwell (2028), and Bruce Shields appointed May 13, 2025 to a seat expiring 2026; Shields's seat stood in 2026 with no published outcome, so two are minted.
